content.short: Digital business bank for startups and SMEs.
content.description: Grasshopper Bank is a US digital-first commercial bank built for startups, small and medium businesses, and the innovation economy. As a chartered, FDIC-member bank, it offers business checking with yield, corporate and virtual cards, SBA and commercial lending, venture and fund banking, and embedded banking services for fintech partners. Grasshopper targets founders and growing companies that want modern online banking with real banking infrastructure behind it, rather than a fintech layered on a partner bank. Its combination of business accounts, cards, and lending, plus API-based embedded finance, makes payments and financial operations a core part of how startups and SMEs manage money through the platform.
